ratings.comment: I don't know if it is because this class was online for the first time, but I just didn't feel like he really taught me. We mostly learned from the textbook assignments and the class was so big it was hard to get participation points. He always posts the rubric and is an easy grader though. Lots of homework, but few tests/quizzes/essays
I respect any TA that lets me draw in class. Plus, total babe.

Easygoing guy as long as you come to class.  Fun because he plays Spanish music before every class.  Really slow on returning exams, homework, compositions, etc.  Not always able to explain complex grammar of Spanish.  Sometimes seemed like he didn't know the correct wording to use.  If you like the hands off approach, you will do fine.
he's a really great guy and a good TA. i'm really glad i took spanish with him
he is amiable and is willing to meet with students anytime.  if the discussion got heated... it was because he was in the room! muy caliente!
Good teacher.  Will meet with you any time, in fact begged us to visit him!!!  He gets class going and is fun and willing to laugh and joke around too (just make sure its in spanish)
